WHY MIA’S PLACE EXISTS

A little joy.
A world of
possibility.

Every child deserves support, belonging, and room to thrive.

Our family’s experience with autism inspired a simple idea: build a candy brand with helping autistic children at its heart.

That’s the purpose behind Mia’s Place. Our ambition is to help fund organizations that support autistic children and their families.

✳

We’re developing the giving program now. Before launch, we’ll share our charity partners, exactly how purchases contribute, and how we’ll report the support provided.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

The little
details.

When can I buy Mia’s Place gummies?

We’re still developing the products and planning the launch. Sales aren’t open yet. Launch updates will include availability, pricing, and where to buy.

Will the gummies have less sugar?

That’s our formulation goal, with taste as the priority. Final ingredients, allergen information, nutrition facts, and the sugar comparison will be shared before launch.

What comes in a pouch?

Our planned format is 8–10 gummies in each small sachet, with several sachets inside a resealable outer pouch. The outer-pouch quantity and net weights are still being finalized.

How will purchases support the mission?

We’re building a giving program to support organizations helping autistic children and their families. Partners and the contribution amount are still being finalized. Before sales begin, we’ll explain exactly where the money goes and how we’ll report it.
